$meta.name: Vimshottari design tokens
$meta.source: Figma variables (file mP16YA7x9BH1Ee0qPoSwDN), reconciled against new-structure.md §4.2 and §5.1
$meta.note: THE single source of design values. Never hand-edit a generated file. Run `npm run build --workspace @vim/tokens` after changing this, and commit the output so a clean checkout builds without the generator.
$meta.supersedes: lib/theme/tokens.dart and the Figma frames, per new-structure.md status line

surface.$comment: Dark neumorphism on the web lives or dies on these five values. The base is mid-dark, never black: a light shadow needs something to lift off. §5.1 sets the base at #17181C.

ink.$comment: Soft shadows steal perceived contrast, so the low-contrast look must never reach the text layer. `primary` is >=7:1 on the base (AAA) per §5.1; nothing below `faint` may carry meaning alone.
ink.label: #5C6270

brass.$comment: Brass is the colour for TIME — time-left pills, countdowns, primary actions. Never used for anything that is not temporal or a primary action, so 'brass means a clock is running' is learned once.
brass.label: #6B5B36

planet.$comment: ring paints the wheel. track is the unfilled arc at 12% of the ring colour (§4.2) so an empty ring still says WHICH ring it is. tabFill/tabInk paint plan stage tabs: the tab is its own hue deepened, everything on it a lighter shade of the SAME hue. glyph and texture are the non-colour identity channels required by M9 — roughly 8% of male users cannot reliably separate Mars red from Mercury green.

shadow.$comment: §5.1 verbatim: raised is a light source up-left, pressed is the identical values as inset. NO BORDERS anywhere — a border on a neumorphic surface is the tell that someone applied the style without the logic.

radius.$comment: §5.1 sets the card radius at 24. Concentric rule: outer radius = inner radius + padding, so a 12px child in 8px padding sits in a 20px parent. Mismatched nested corners are the most visible amateur tell.

type.$comment: Inter first: it carries the Sanskrit diacritics (ā ś ṣ ṁ ṛ) that many display faces drop. Verify any substitute against 'Śani Antardaśā'. Sizes are rem so 200% Dynamic Type scales the whole ramp (M9).
type.family: Inter, 'Inter Variable', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif
type.caption: 0.6875rem
type.title: 1.3125rem

motion.$comment: §4.2: rings sweep 0 -> current on every mount, staggered 80ms outer-inward, 900ms each, easeOutCubic. Total choreography must stay under 1.3s or it stops reading as 'loading my life' and starts reading as slow. A progress ring that bounces past its value would be a lie, so the curve never overshoots — except at >97%, where a 3px settle makes 'almost done' felt.

wheel.$comment: §4.2 geometry spec, single source, three implementations. Outermost = fastest (Prana/Messenger): the outer ring has the most arc-length per pixel, so the thing that visibly changes gets the most room. NOTE: the spec states stroke 22 with an 8 gap, which implies radii 30 apart, but gives radii 28 apart. The explicit radii win; the rendered gap is 6.

layout.$comment: The web build is a website that also runs as a phone app, not a phone app stretched across a monitor. These are real layout changes. `measure` caps reading columns at 68ch (§5.1) even when the page around them is 1600px wide.
